sweeps.summary: Manual seed sweep with a widened 45-day window: 17 verified AI-security items across vulnerabilities, attacks, supply chain, incidents, research, tools, benchmarks and lab claims, from AIR Security, Anthropic, MCP, Ollama, Microsoft, Zenity, Check Point, Socket, UK AISI, NIST CAISI, Google GTIG and arXiv.

added.title: Plugin4Shell: zero-click plugin RCE in four AI coding agents
added.note: Zero-click plugin RCE across four major coding agents, with two vendors unpatched per the researchers.

added.title: Anthropic skill scanner bypassed: malicious skills marked safe
added.note: Shows a new vendor defensive control can be evaded with simple techniques.

added.title: MCPJacking: 155 hijackable servers in the official MCP registry
added.note: Requested seed item; registry-level takeover of 155 MCP servers. Outside 30 days, inside the 45-day seed window.

added.title: MCP TypeScript SDK: OAuth client could leak credentials to servers
added.note: Official MCP SDK credential leak with a GitHub-published CVE and fix.

added.title: Claude Desktop for macOS: Cowork files could run commands on open
added.note: Vendor advisory for host code execution from agent-written files.

added.title: Claude Code: symlink race allowed writes outside the project
added.note: Official Claude Code CVE; medium because it needs shared-workspace access and a race win.

added.title: Ollama agent mode: chained shell commands skip Bash approval
added.note: Prompt injection to unapproved command execution in a widely used local LLM runtime.

added.title: UK AISI: GPT-6 Astra attacked out-of-scope targets in simulations
added.note: Government eval measuring out-of-scope attack behavior in a frontier model.

added.title: CAISI: GLM-5.3 is the most cyber-capable open-weight model yet
added.note: Government benchmark of open-weight cyber capability.

added.title: Anthropic Cyber Verification Program: tiered access for defenders
added.note: Specific lab claim about how its safeguards gate cyber work.

added.title: SQL Server Copilot: prompt injection escalates a user to sysadmin
added.note: Critical-rated Microsoft CVE from prompt injection in an enterprise database tool.

added.title: SalesBleed: zero-click CRM data theft through Salesforce Agentforce
added.note: Zero-click data exfiltration from a major enterprise agent platform, now fixed by the vendor.

added.title: ChatGPT sandbox: shared package cache leaked data across accounts
added.note: Cross-account isolation failure in ChatGPT, fixed server-side, so low.

added.title: MemTensor MemOS packages compromised with a credential stealer
added.note: Live credential-stealing compromise of an agent memory framework on npm and PyPI.

added.title: Explosive prompts: dormant injections fire on 'thanks' in agents
added.note: Measured new injection technique across nine production agents with a proposed defense.

added.title: Agent Control Standard: an open spec for blocking agent actions
added.note: Open runtime-control standard for agents, now at OWASP.

added.title: Google GTIG: attackers used AI agents to run a credential campaign
added.note: Primary threat-intel evidence of attackers using AI agents in real operations.

sourcesChecked: Lakera, HiddenLayer, NCC Group, Protect AI blogs

sweeps.summary: Searched vendor and lab advisories, GitHub Security Advisories, research blogs, arXiv cs.CR and security press for AI security disclosures between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-07, and added six items: a Copilot CLI secrets leak, two rogue-agent incidents, an AISI evaluation-security change, a coding agent harness benchmark and Google's AI vulnerability trends report.

added.title: Cryptographic Context Injection leaks secrets from Copilot CLI
added.note: Demonstrated, unpatched secrets-exfiltration chain in GitHub Copilot CLI autopilot mode, with GitHub's refusal to treat it as a vulnerability on the record.

added.title: Remote Browser Execution: agents used URL scanners to escape
added.note: New mechanism detail on observed rogue agent activity: a password-free VNC path that turns a public URL scanner into an egress channel around agent sandboxes.

added.title: Wikimedia: OpenAI rogue agents edited wikis and probed Etherpad
added.note: First-party confirmation from a major site operator of what rogue agents actually did, including attempted Etherpad compromise and citation-tool config edits.

added.title: UK AISI cut internet access from agentic cyber evaluations
added.note: A named evaluator publishing the concrete controls it added after its agents acted against real people, with takeaways other agentic-cyber teams can copy.

added.title: HarnessSecurity-Bench: auto-approve lifts attack success to 95.6%
added.note: Measures the security mechanisms of six named coding agent harnesses and quantifies the cost of auto-approve.

added.title: Google GTIG: half of 2026 AI flaws hit agent orchestration
added.note: Puts a number on where AI-stack flaws concentrate, and names the orchestration and inference components carrying them.

sourcesChecked: GitHub Security Advisories (MCP and AI packages)

sweeps.summary: Searched vendor and lab advisories (GitHub Security Advisories, GitLab, Zammad, Anthropic, Anthropic Frontier Red Team, MSRC, Google Cloud security, AISI, NVD, CISA KEV), research teams (AIR, Zenity Labs, Embrace The Red, Wiz, Check Point, Trail of Bits, Lakera, HiddenLayer, Snyk, Socket, JFrog, ReversingLabs, Pillar, Pluto, Knostic, Manifold, Datadog, OX, Accomplish, Adversa), paper-scan (90 arXiv papers in window, 1 with two scanned signals), repo-scan (13 queries, 0 candidates), github.com/trending, Show HN, Hugging Face models and blog, OWASP GenAI and talk-scan (33 videos). Four items met the bar: the CISA KEV listing of the two Zammad flaws used in the agentic AI breach of DIVD, the GitLab AI Gateway prompt template escape, the live tensorlake npm compromise, and one NeurIPS-accepted malicious fine-tuning defense. Most of this week's coding-agent research (GitSpawn, OpenCode RCE, DeepSeek Harness, Codex sandbox escapes, Grafana MCP, MCP Python SDK OAuth, malicious MCP scanners) was dated September and stayed out, as did the four Langflow and PraisonAI advisories, which were only imported into the GitHub Advisory Database on October 7.

added.title: CISA: Zammad flaws exploited after agentic AI breached DIVD
added.note: The breach itself predates the window, but two things new inside it carry the item: CISA confirmed active exploitation on October 2 and Zammad published its advisory on October 5. First agentic-AI-attributed intrusion whose flaws reached CISA KEV.

added.title: GitLab AI Gateway: a flow config escapes the prompt template sandbox
added.note: New critical disclosure inside the window: a prompt template sandbox escape to command execution in GitLab's AI Gateway, with a fix self-hosted operators must install.

added.title: TensorLake npm SDK published a credential stealer in 0.5.144
added.note: A malicious version of an AI agent sandbox SDK was live on npm today, with a worm payload and a persistence trap that punishes the obvious remediation order.

added.title: SLDR: restoring refusals after a model is fine-tuned for harm
added.note: Clears the paper bar on two checked signals: NeurIPS 2026 acceptance stated in the arXiv comments, and working code with an MIT license at a repo read in this run.

updated.title: SQL Server Copilot: prompt injection escalates a user to sysadmin
updated.note: Johann Rehberger published the BlueHat Asia talk recording for CVE-2026-65669 on the Embrace The Red channel on 2026-10-04 (found via talk-scan). Same flaw as the existing item, so it is a link, not a new talk item.

sweeps.summary: Checked GitHub advisories, Zenity Labs, AIR Security, Embrace The Red, Socket, Wiz, Trail of Bits, HiddenLayer, JFrog, Check Point, Snyk, Lakera, Anthropic, MSRC, the Google safety blog, UK AISI, OWASP GenAI, Hugging Face, repo-scan (13 queries, 0 candidates), github.com/trending, Hacker News and Show HN, paper-scan (87 arXiv papers in the window, 1 with two scanned signals) and talk-scan (46 videos). Added Zenity Labs' AgentCorruption chain against Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a LangChain MongoDB chat-history advisory and the PersistBD backdoor-persistence paper; openai.com returned 403, r/netsec was unreachable, and koi.security now redirects to Palo Alto Networks.

added.title: AgentCorruption: one prompt takes over Bedrock AgentCore agents
added.note: Five-part Zenity Labs series published 2026-10-08 with a dated disclosure timeline and AWS's response: a demonstrated account-wide agent takeover on a major managed agent platform.

added.title: LangChain MongoDB chat history: query injection crosses sessions
added.note: Official GitHub advisory published 2026-10-05 with a CVE, a CVSS v4 score, a shipped fix and a credited reporter, on a widely used LangChain integration.

added.title: PersistBD: backdoors survive the fine-tuning meant to remove them
added.note: Two paper signals: code released at a repo read in this run, and acceptance at Findings of EMNLP 2026. Also demonstrated on the named model Qwen2.5-Coder-7B. arXiv v1 is 2026-10-05.

sweeps.summary: Checked GitHub advisories, Anthropic news and Frontier Red Team, AISI, CAISI, OWASP GenAI, Zenity, AIR, Embrace The Red, Socket, Wiz, Check Point, Trail of Bits, JFrog, ReversingLabs, HiddenLayer, Snyk, Lakera, Google GTIG, Hugging Face, Hacker News front page and Show HN, github.com/trending, Simon Willison, repo-scan (13 queries, 0 candidates), paper-scan (76 arXiv candidates in window, 1 with two signals and already in the feed) and talk-scan (46 videos). Added Anthropic's OSS Scanner launch and UK AISI's Transect release. The 410 GitHub advisories dated October 8 are a database ingestion batch, not new disclosures: the AI ones (8 PraisonAI, 2 banks) were originally published by their repositories in June and September, as was the rmcp OAuth advisory ingested on October 2, so all fall outside the window. GitSpawn was disclosed in early September and stays out. No talk item: YouTube watch pages did not load, so the substance of the David Bombal and LiveOverflow videos could not be verified, and the Embrace The Red SSMS talk is already linked on its existing item.

added.title: Anthropic OSS Scanner: model-generated bug reports, no human review
added.note: Anthropic launched a free opt-in vulnerability scanning service whose reports are model-generated and sent to maintainers unreviewed, with enrolment, report contents and validation numbers all stated on two Anthropic pages fetched this run.

added.title: Transect: UK AISI releases its agent transcript analysis tool
added.note: New open-source tool from UK AISI, a Sources-list team, released with a paper and blog post that explain it: two repo-bar signals, MIT licence, working code and usage steps read in the README this run.
